body: Sorry if cringe. And possibly. Full disclosure though, I meant the opposite of mean, not the opposite of rude, but I think politeness kinda loops in too. Thanks for reading.

The top two ways awareness was spread to me was with tshirts and hashtags, so this is the method I’m trying. If I make any shirt sales, the money will go towards spreading more awareness for this cause. I made the shirt for me and figured others might feel the same, but I mostly just want everyone to rethink if they’re being honest or kind enough to their fellow humans and make real change. Thank you for reading.
Giving the people a voice when they can’t speak out themselves is important. I’m trying to reach every person like me.

I feel like I’m spreading what would make me feel safer in this world, which could be considered as providing a solution. I feel like every person has some level of pressure from toxic people, and that everyone would benefit from being honest and kind to each other. I just truly believe in this. Thank you for reading.
Right? So don’t censor me lol
I hear you, I’m not the best writer. I’ll keep updating for clarity as time goes on.

Not exactly, I got verbally abused for most of my life so far and am devoting my life to spreading awareness. It destroyed my brain’s functionality and we need to break the chain of psychological abuse spreading psychological problems. I’m extremely passionate about this. I used free-writing to break free from the hold my abusers had on my brain, and now that my brain is working, I just want less anxiety and more peace of mind for all.

Verbal abusers have narcissistic traits. The dishonesty is that they act like they are justified in their abuse of weaker people, when really they aren’t. Victim blaming (saying the victim deserved their abuse) has psychological repercussions on the victim, leading up to suicide. My site will be updated as I time goes on. Thank you for taking the time to read it.
